line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Most variables have been removed from the config file to prevent exploits. See version history on GitHub for old t-file information.
* Faction innate specialization bonuses (always 0) and ethos (variable)
* Xenon terrritory and OCV fleet power triggers. Note: add +1 to max to ensure bounds are within X to Y rather than X to Y-1.
* Pirate Galaxy Limit Multiplier was deprecated as it's always 100%. See ZH.Initialize.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Changed from 200 to 100. 200 takes a very long time to achieve and player could sneak in ships long before in order to get the wares.
* Chance out of 1000, i.e. 2.0% (1 decimal point).
* Grace period after conquering and abandoning a sector (changed from 24 to 2 hours since Add-Ons 2.2).
* Mayhem.IsClaimable scales the delay depending on difficulty.
* Chance has 1 decimal point of precision (25.0%)
* Add-Ons 2.2: Overextension limit changed from 150 to 333.
* Average supply is roughly 475 generated per sector on insane. As a rule of thumb, around 70% of the population goes to military.
* 475 * .7 ~= 333. 150 was too low and easily beaten with some fighters.
* Player nation milestones (fleet power, sectors, cash, resources)
* See ZH.Initialize for Jump Beacons, Jump Stations, and Grace Radius caps.
* Validate in case. Use default if invalid.
* Remove existing cargo indicators if disabled.
